title: Strategically Analogous Mechanisms
abstract: arXiv:2605.12802v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper studies when strategic understanding acquired in one mechanism can be transferred to another. It introduces a framework in which agents have a limited understanding of how actions affect payoffs, and formalizes how they use analogies to transfer this understanding between mechanisms. We ask when such reasoning allows agents to transfer their understanding of equilibrium between mechanisms. We first consider mechanisms that are strategically equivalent---that is, share the same game form up to relabeling of actions---and show that agents' understanding of equilibrium transfers once they recognize how the actions in these mechanisms map to one another. We then define strategic analogy, a weaker notion that allows actions and types to be remapped, and show that equilibrium understanding transfers once agents recognize how the actions and types in these mechanisms relate. translated_abstract: 本文研究在一个机制中获得的策略性理解何时能够迁移到另一个机制中。文章引入了一个框架，其中参与者对行为如何影响收益的理解是有限的，并形式化了他们如何利用类比在机制之间迁移这种理解。我们探讨这种推理在何种条件下能够使参与者在机制之间迁移其对均衡的理解。我们首先考虑策略等价的机制——即在对行为进行重新标记的意义上共享相同的博弈形式——并证明一旦参与者认识到这些机制中行为之间的对应关系，他们对均衡的理解便可以迁移。随后，我们定义了“策略类比”这一更弱的概念，它允许对行为和类型进行重新映射，并证明一旦参与者认识到这些机制中行为和类型之间的关系，均衡理解便可迁移。应用包括单物品拍卖、评分拍卖等。
tldr: 本文提出“策略类比”框架，研究有限理解的参与者如何通过类比在机制间迁移均衡理解，并证明在策略等价或更弱的策略类比关系下，均衡理解可以跨机制迁移。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a framework of strategically analogous mechanisms, showing that agents with limited understanding can transfer equilibrium knowledge across mechanisms through strategic equivalence or weaker strategic analogies of actions and types.
